author: Synthetic Generator
content:
In this fictional follow-up, SpaceXAI said the first scheduled batch of 220,000 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs for its Colossus expansion had completed installation and entered operational service.

Musk had previously described that batch as scheduled to become operational the following week. The new statement reports completion of that previously announced phase, not a separate supercomputer project.

The company said the remaining planned batches for November and potentially December were unchanged. It did not revise the existing Colossus 1 or Colossus 2 GPU inventory figures.

This later operational confirmation is new information about the same Colossus GPU expansion event.
headline: SpaceX brings 220k NVIDIA GB300 GPU cluster online ahead of schedule
summary: Engineers confirmed all 220,000 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs are fully operational in the Colossus supercluster.
